_doc: Read by /wp-plugin-smoke skill. Plugin-specific values that vary across the portfolio (slug, base URL, version constant, Basecamp project) live here so the skill itself can stay generic.
name: WB Listora
_resolution_note: base_url and wp_path are derived at run time from the plugin directory (wp_path = three levels up; base_url = wp option get siteurl) and the host is reachability-checked before dispatch. Stored absolute paths go stale silently and the walk then passes against nothing. Set a literal value here only for a non-standard layout, in which case it is used as a fallback.
